row.body: My cab entry says the orchard treatment workers brushed off a cloying orchard smell. the horse kicked away its feed before the crossing was barricaded.
row.title: Cab note — during the hot afternoon

sidecar.gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
sidecar.rival_reading: Responders could have collected the a cloying orchard smell while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
